cards.title: Expression Shift
cards.prompt: Let the miniFigure that doesn’t fully match your current mood — just slightly off.

cards.title: Color Drift
cards.prompt: Add one color you almost never pick for yourself.

cards.title: Style Drift
cards.prompt: Let the outfit lean into a style you usually wouldn’t wear.

cards.title: Fantasy Tilt
cards.prompt: Nudge the look toward fantasy/adventure — just a touch.

cards.title: Headwear Shift
cards.prompt: Add a hairstyle or hat you’ve never worn before.

cards.title: Hat with a Story
cards.prompt: Give the figure a hat with a hint of story or mystery.

cards.title: Unreal Object
cards.prompt: Give the figure one item that doesn’t fully belong to real life. (magic, sci-fi, dream-logic, whimsical)

cards.title: Local Object Interpretation
cards.prompt: Local participant picks an object from the room — build the closest LEGO interpretation of it.

cards.title: Local Rule Injection
cards.prompt: A local member assigns a constraint: one required color / style / odd detail the figure must include.

cards.title: Gentle Challenge
cards.prompt: Add one tiny element that feels 'not quite you.'
